'''Eri Kitamura''' (Japanese: '''喜多村英梨''' ''Kitamura Eri'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kitamura was born on August 16, 1987, in {{wp|Fuchū, Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as a teenager. She was affiliated with the talent agency Early Wing. Kitamura provided her voice for the [[Virbank City]] Gym Leader [[Roxie]] in {{aniseries|BW}}, as well as the [[Rustboro City]] Gym Leader [[Roxanne]] in the [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Animated Trailer]]. In addition to voice acting and singing, Kitamura is an amateur manga artist.
